description: Defines classes and templates for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, including test utilities for simulating and waiting for callback results in the Chromium project.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallback
classes.description: A test utility class for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, providing methods to wait for results and generate callback functions.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallback
classes.description: A specialized callback class for 64-bit integer results, used in testing asynchronous operations.

classes.name: ReleaseBufferCompletionCallback
classes.description: A callback class that ensures an IOBuffer is not referenced after the callback runs, used in testing buffer management.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback function that sets the result of the callback object.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Blocks until the asynchronous operation completes and returns the result.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the result of the callback, invoked when the asynchronous operation completes.
